title: One page of the Commerce Commission's case register listing (www.comcom.govt.nz/case-register/, HTML)

landmarks: a listing component carrying :total="N" (the register's own count of entries) and :results-count="100"

up to 100 <div class="card card--has-link"> blocks, each with card__status--open|closed, an <a class="card__link" href="/case-register/case-register-entries/<slug>/"> title, card__info-title pairs (Outcome:, Date Closed:) and a card__tag (the category)

signals_note: GET https://www.comcom.govt.nz/case-register/?q=&size=100&page=N through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page with no :total and no cards is not this shape (a block page, an error page).
notes: Seen 21 October 2026: total 1727, 100 cards a page, newest first. A card's title is the parties as published, or 'Withheld'. The card's status, outcome, closing date and tag are the item's fingerprint: an entry is fetched again only when they change.
applies_to: the Commission's case register listing, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; a page not of this shape stops the pass (set aside).
One listed item per card: the entry's slug and address, and its fingerprint (status, outcome, date closed, tag).
gates: The pass's distinct slugs equal the first page's :total within 2 (check.py).
on_fail: set the page aside; the pass resumes from it next run

by: regulators-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One entry of the Commerce Commission's case register (www.comcom.govt.nz/case-register/case-register-entries/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: case-details__record blocks, each a case-details__record-title and a case-details__record-value: Parties, Category, Sub-category, Act/Section/Part, Industry, Status, Outcome, Case number, Date opened, Date closed, Contact person

signals_note: GET the entry's address from the listing, through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page without the Case Details block is not this shape.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026 on seven entries. Parties are separated by '; ' where the Commission separates them, and sometimes not at all ('Mohawk Industries, Inc. Godfrey Hirst New Zealand Limited and Bremworth Limited'). 'Withheld' is the Commission's own withholding (it does not name an individual in a civil matter; Enforcement Response Guidelines). A trading name follows 't/a'. Case number is a project number (PRJ0049016), a determination ([2026] NZCC 25), a judgment ([2021] NZHC 2279) or empty (1991 entries). Act/Section/Part reads like 'Commerce Act 1986 ss 30, 80(1)'. The Contact person is Commission staff and is never read. The summary paragraph and the timeline are not read.
applies_to: the Commission's case register entries, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.
One case row keyed by the entry's slug (the Commission's page address), with its case number where stated; the Act and section as stated, split into each Act and its sections.

One party row per party the Parties field names: split on '; ' and on ' and ' between two names that each carry a legal ending; otherwise the field is one party as published. A trading name after 't/a' is kept beside its party. A company number is read only where the page prints one beside the name (NZBN or company number).
A party is withheld (row kept, name empty) where the Commission writes 'Withheld', or where the page states a suppression and the party carries no organisation word.
gates: Every listed entry is a case row, a catch-log line or 'not captured' (check.py).
No withheld party shows a name on a view; no street address in any published text column (check.py).
